levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «قالا حدثنا» makes the two shaykhs co-transmitters of one level; «جميعاً» makes the three names of the next level co-transmitters that meet at عبد الرحمن بن أبي نجران
«قال سمعته يقول: قال رسول الله» is the Companion-free saying; the Prophet is not a link and the chain ends at the Imam written in the chain after «عن»
